output.explanation: Implemented all seven B04 edits using the pinned endpoint sources. Selection now separates explicit node membership from transient gestures and native ownership. The composer hands structured create/edit/extend requests to the retained generation/application lifecycle, including subtree validation and idempotent installation. Programmable mutations, context uploads, application persistence, and AI execution have distinct access boundaries. Existing attachment labels are retained; only the planned composer-to-service edge is added. These boundaries support later context retention and variants without depicting those later features as implemented. Layout constraint: C02/D00 is a 13-by-1 placeholder, too small even for the required service attachment label. Its required tree therefore exceeds that placeholder; its identity and position remain unchanged.

Selection State Boundaries
|-- CanvasSession: committed semantic selection
|   `-- SelectionState: membership and insertion order
|       |-- items[]: unique id / displayNodeId; region absent = whole
|       `-- region: sourceContentId / sourceRevisionId / sourceAscii
|           |-- contentNodeIds: ordered canonical node membership
|           |-- rect: presentation envelope; legacy membership fallback
|           `-- selectedIds: source-mapping nodes, separate from content
|-- SelectionCommands: shared reducer and controller mutation path
|   |-- replace / add / toggleDiagram / remove / clear
|   |-- regionSelectionItem: capture intersecting content + source IDs
|   |-- Whole diagrams and regions may coexist; no implicit exclusion
|   |-- Equivalent captured regions reuse identity; preserve order
|   `-- Panel visibility does not determine membership
|-- toggleSubtreeSelection
|   |-- Clicked root decides add/remove; folded descendants follow
|   |-- Add explicit subtree IDs; remove them from matching selections
|   `-- Keep residual membership/envelope; drop emptied selections
|-- syncNativeDiagramSelection
|   `-- Synchronize whole-diagram items while retaining region items
|-- syncSelectionPresentation: all writers, including restore/history
|   `-- Mirror captured IDs into display regions and control surfaces
|-- Input adapters: CanvasSelectionLayer -> MappingCanvas
|   |-- SelectionGestureController: screen-space recognition only
|   |   |-- Mouse/pen slop 4px; touch slop 10px
|   |   |-- Touch -> pan; no selection completion on finger release
|   |   |-- Mouse Ctrl -> marquee; Shift without Meta -> blocked
|   |   |-- Pen select -> marquee; hand -> pan; node/native/move paths
|   |   |-- SelectionPolicy: mouse add; direct input add or replace
|   |   `-- Multiple contacts cancel; block until all contacts leave
|   |-- Completion -> tap or marquee -> controller membership update
|   |-- Ctrl node click -> subtree toggle; node tap -> captured region
|   |-- Mouse double-click -> whole; Ctrl/Meta -> toggle whole
|   |-- Panel select-source -> captured region; explicit deselect
|   `-- GesturePreview: bounds/promotion only; cancel discards preview
|       `-- Escape, lost capture, pointer cancel, blur or tool change
|-- NativeSelectionOwnership: application/native latch
|   |-- DOM release does not transfer ownership back to native
|   |-- Native-owned settle synchronizes whole diagrams, keeps regions
|   `-- Application-owned settle restores native whole-shape selection
|-- Editor owns transient geometry; no move/camera controller writes
|   `-- settle -> commitEditorGesture: movement, panes and selection
|-- Consumers: highlights, count/toolbar, copy/move/code/chat actions
|   |-- Clipboard: complete rows + indentation and selected code refs
|   |   `-- Explicit holes -> selected node spans; never restore holes
|   `-- WebSocket: diagramIds + captured regions/source/rect/text/stale
|       `-- Initial snapshot/deltas -> server mirror -> readers
|-- UI interaction state: action-menu and keyboard focus
`-- PanelState: code/chat/projection source context; independent life
    `-- Layout, expansion and focus survive selection removal

Native Canvas Runtime
|-- MappingEditorCanvas: mounted editor integration
|   |-- creates CanvasRuntime per session; mounts Tldraw/MappingShapeUtil + Editor
|   |-- installs MappingEditorRuntime with controller and shared ownership
|   |-- camera -> ApplicationOverlay scale(z) translate(x,y); no React camera state
|   |   |-- restore: x=offset.x/scale+190, y=offset.y/scale+64
|   |   `-- save: offset=((x-190)*z,(y-64)*z), scale=z -> SourcePaneViewState
|   `-- unmount/rebind: settle; detach driver/listeners/selectionTools; clear Editor
|-- Interaction boundary: CanvasSelectionLayer <-> native tools
|   |-- SelectionToolBridge: CanvasRuntime.gestures; WeakMap keyed by Editor
|   |-- MappingSelectTool / MappingHandTool: suppress claimed pointer events
|   |   `-- cancel on tool exit; suppress delayed non-mouse double-click phases
|   |-- Move handle -> native pointing_shape translation; retain app membership
|   |-- Touch temporarily uses Hand; native pan/pinch receives contacts
|   |-- Restore tool after settlement; cancellation rolls back native movement
|   `-- Gesture previews stay transient; completed membership rules are in C01
|-- MappingEditorRuntime: semantic controller <-> live Editor
|   |-- hydrate(): editorHistory(); replay past/head/reverse(future), undo to head
|   |   `-- stopping points + checkpoint refs; old geometry loads on navigation
|   |-- attachEditorDriver({settle, undo}); command: complete -> settle(true,false)
|   |-- projectMappingShapes(snapshot) -> writeShapes(record); retain baseline
|   |   |-- grid cells * cell size (fallback 8.4 x 18); parents; locked root
|   |   |-- visible floats -> shapes; exclude code-panel/source-code
|   |   `-- locked selections/edges; arrows behind; app whole-selection -> native
|   |-- publish(): stopping point + shapes + mappingCheckpoint document metadata
|   |   `-- shared history diff; defer same checkpoint while pointer is down
|   |-- store shape/selection -> dirty; idle tick waits for pointing to end
|   |   |-- no move/camera publication; grid moves round to nonnegative cells
|   |   |-- supported clones -> duplicate-instance; cancel other native clones
|   |   `-- floating move/resize -> manual geometry; resize fixes sizing
|   |-- NativeSelectionOwnership: default application; controller change claims it
|   |   |-- native capture -> syncNativeDiagramSelection; region items survive
|   |   `-- no capture -> restore semantic whole-shape selection, history ignored
|   |-- commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas) -> one semantic checkpoint
|   |-- undo/redo: complete + settle; reject transfer-linked boundary; else Editor
|   |-- document hook -> restoreEditorCheckpoint -> publish(false); no new edit
|   `-- dispose(): complete + settle; remove subscriptions in reverse order
|-- CanvasRuntime
|   |-- retains session/controller, optional Editor, previous snapshot, registry
|   |-- connect -> controller.subscribe(sync); cleanup unsubscribes
|   |-- sync: document/display/diagramViews/selection/cell; transact + shareEqual
|   |-- per-ID Models<GridModel>, Models<FloatModel>, Models<EdgeModel> atoms
|   |-- grids: frame/diagram/view/node/cell/selected content/jumps/layoutKey
|   |-- floats: pane/parent/root/selected/missing/stale/visible/source revision
|   |-- edges: logical edge + source/target estimates/layout keys
|   |-- interaction/catalog atoms; actions include undo/escape; availability atoms
|   |-- updateDisplay -> controller.updateCanvas; mutations behind commands
|   |-- focusedEdge: transient {id, point}; sync clears when edge removed
|   `-- LocalAnchorStore: transient shape-local endpoint rectangles
|       |-- identity atom + layoutKey; round measurements to 0.01 pixels
|       |-- useLocalAnchors: (DOM rect - body origin) / local scale
|       |-- ResizeObserver/layout/font events measure; fonts invalidate
|       |-- layoutKey: content revision/hash, view, cell, collapse
|       `-- invalidate changed layouts/remove owners; retain on culling/camera
|-- NativeConnection -> nativeEdgeGeometry
|   |-- subscribe to edge definition, both local anchors and editor transforms
|   |-- content: measured rect or estimate; whole shape: Editor geometry bounds
|   |-- parent-inclusive page transform: four corners -> drawResolvedEdge
|   |   `-- page-space endpoints retain measured/estimated status
|   |-- 14px hit path: click screenToPage / Enter midpoint -> toggle focus
|   `-- respect subtreeDisabled and pan; Space stays available for panning
`-- ConnectionFocus: endpoint navigation replaces connection editing
    |-- edgeFocusPosition: nearest nonzero route segment, clamped projection
    |-- pageToScreen minus viewport origin -> hint; zoom scales endpoint outlines
    |-- buttons or [ / ] -> centerOnPoint(endpoint center), 180ms animation
    |-- Escape/outside click/invalid focus clears; canvas pan retains focus
    |-- typing/modifier keys ignored; cleanup removes global listeners
    `-- camera/focus only: no edge-definition or selection-history mutation

Prompt Composer Flow
`-- PromptComposerCoordinator
    |-- Owns entries, activeKey, carried reference, cursors and poll timers
    |   |-- Target key: operation + documentId + nodeId; fresh opens use UUID
    |   |-- Entry: target, PromptDraft, pending, exact request, run and error
    |   `-- UI lifetime independent of selection, panels and undo
    |-- Targets: canvasId / documentId / nodeId / label
    |   |-- create-diagram: anchor diagram or canvas; count 1..4
    |   |-- edit-diagram: selected subtree ID + revision; required by composer
    |   `-- extend-diagram: source anchors + chosen nonnegative canvas origin
    |-- PromptDraft
    |   |-- Template: ID/version/options; optional edited Markdown
    |   |   `-- Switching template resets options and edited Markdown
    |   |-- Body: text/reference blocks; text between references and at ends
    |   |-- Insert at cursor; clone pinned reference; at most 20 references
    |   `-- Operation change resets template/count and prior request/run
    |-- Reference inputs
    |   |-- Revision list -> carry -> insert into prompt or place on canvas
    |   |-- Manual reference chips have no live-selection binding
    |   `-- syncSelections(documentId): selection identity -> automatic chip
    |       |-- Active matching document only; paused while request unsettled
    |       |-- Add/update chips from captured revision references
    |       |-- Deselect removes chip; unavailable snapshot retains old chip
    |       `-- User-removed chip stays absent until deselect/reselect
    |-- submit(key)
    |   |-- Serialize text + [ref N] citations and ordered pinned references
    |   |-- Reject empty prompt or missing edit/extension target information
    |   |-- client.capture -> sessionId / expectedVersion / baseRevisionId
    |   |-- Clone template; add operation fields; allocate requestId
    |   |-- Retain exact request BEFORE sending; lock unsettled draft/target
    |   `-- DiagramEditClient.start(request, operation)
    |       `-- DiagramEditService
    |           `-- Backend owns generation and canvas application; see D01
    |-- accept(run) -> store status; poll generating/applying every 750ms
    |   `-- refresh deduplicates reads; ignores superseded in-flight results
    |-- retry: resend exact request if response lost or acknowledgement pending
    |   `-- Otherwise refresh existing run; no retained request -> submit
    |-- cancel: only while generating; backend decides resulting status
    |-- close: hide active entry and clear carried reference; retain drafts
    |-- dismiss: only settled entry; remove entry, cursor and timer
    `-- dispose: stop updates and clear polling timers

Contextual Diagram Editing
|-- Connected reader uploads trajectory
|   `-- LiveCanvasService.uploadAgentContext()
|       `-- AgentContextService.upload(scope, requestId, trajectory)
|           |-- AgentContext.fromTrajectory() [D3]
|           `-- Immutable backend-lifetime context -> agentContextId + contentHash
|-- Generated operation entries
|   |-- edit-diagram(input) [D1]
|   |-- create-diagram(input): create new diagram(s), anchor or empty canvas
|   `-- extend-diagram(input): create one diagram connected to source anchors
`-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.call(input)
    |-- Validate API input and live attachment; resolve operation
    |-- AgentContextService.get(workspace/document, agentContextId)
    |   `-- Resolve optional uploaded context for this attachment
    `-- DiagramEditService.start(input, suppliedContext) [D2]
        |-- AgentContext.fromSnapshot(suppliedContext) [D3]
        |   `-- Validate and capture immutable snapshot; missing context rejects
        |-- Validate operation/template/options; creation requires canvas.create
        |-- Request key: [sessionId, requestId]; signature includes operation
        |   |-- Changed input/context hash -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
        |   |-- Existing run -> current status, never regenerate
        |   `-- Awaiting acknowledgement -> retry installation of retained output
        |-- Own runId, cloned input/context, AbortController, progress and output
        |   `-- Cancel only generating; dispose aborts eligible runs
        `-- Launch asynchronous DiagramEditService.generate(run)
            |-- 1. Capture and verify the base
            |   |-- canvas.snapshot(sessionId); expectedVersion must match
            |   |-- nodeId -> diagram GridBox; baseRevisionId must match
            |   |-- create at nodeId=canvas -> synthetic empty diagram context
            |   |-- Import captured CanvasHistory; retain exact revision identities
            |   |-- resolvePromptTemplate: operation, ID/version, options, Markdown
            |   |-- resolveReferences: pinned history first, service registry next
            |   |   `-- Validate diagram/range/node IDs -> ASCII or node excerpt
            |   |-- Edit subtree: revision guard -> contiguous diagramSubtreeRange
            |   `-- Extension: validate every source content-node anchor
            |-- 2. RevisionedDiagramService.generate(request, options)
            |   |-- Clone request: context/evidence/edges, references, AgentContext
            |   |-- PiDiagramEditRuntime.generate(request, options)
            |   |   |-- requireEnabled -> resolve model/auth; captured base required
            |   |   |-- renderDiagramEditPrompt -> renderPromptTemplate
            |   |   |   `-- JSON context/references/instruction + option guidance
            |   |   |-- Subtree prompt requires unchanged prefix and suffix
            |   |   |-- PiAgentRuntime.createSession() [D4]
            |   |   |   |-- SessionManager.inMemory(cwd)
            |   |   |   |-- AgentContext.toPiMessages()
            |   |   |   |   `-- Append copied history to manager
            |   |   |   `-- createAgentSession({ sessionManager, ...config })
            |   |   |-- session.prompt -> submit_diagram_edit(candidate)
            |   |   |   |-- Validate schema, content, mappings and subtree scope
            |   |   |   `-- Invalid -> resubmit; valid -> generated content
            |   |   `-- Finally remove abort/progress hooks; dispose/remove session
            |   |-- Whole edit: no subtree range
            |   |   `-- revise(baseRevisionId, { kind: replace, input }) [D5]
            |   |-- Scoped edit: subtreeReplacement verifies unchanged outer lines
            |   |   `-- revise(kind: patch); rebase outside mappings, filter inside
            |   |-- Edit revision: DiagramRevisionEditor.prepareEdit -> issue(base)
            |   |   `-- Same diagramId; new revisionId + parentId; immutable registry
            |   `-- Create/extend: no baseRevisionId -> create new revision identity
            |       `-- Create count 1..4 sequentially; extension generates one
            |-- 3. Retain revision or created[] on run before installation
            `-- 4. install(run): applying; reuse generated output on retry
                |-- Edit -> DiagramEditService.apply(run)
                |   `-- canvas.apply(sessionId, application)
                |       `-- CanvasSessionBridge -> MappingPage
                |           `-- DiagramRevisionReceiver.apply()
                |               |-- Receipt lookup; otherwise controller.applyUpdate
                |               |-- Check document/base versions at mutation boundary
                |               |-- Validate/register exact revision; replace scene
                |               |-- Layout/reconcile edges; history binding/checkpoint
                |               `-- Retain receipt/unresolvedEdgeIds; persist + ack
                |-- Create/extend -> place(run) -> fresh snapshot
                |   |-- Revalidate extension anchors; retry version conflict <=3 times
                |   |-- Place beside anchor/in parent, or at explicit origin
                |   `-- canvas.create(runId, latestVersion, diagrams)
                |       `-- Bridge create-diagrams -> MappingPage receipt lookup
                |           |-- generatedDiagramOperations -> controller.applyUpdate
                |           |-- diagram-create + source-to-new-box edge-create
                |           `-- One undoable update; receipt before flush; retry flush
                `-- Ack -> completed + result/created node IDs and document version
                    `-- Timeout/unavailable/persistence pending -> awaiting-acknowledgement
                        `-- Version conflict -> conflict; other errors -> failed

Structured Generation Requests
|-- Target: sessionId = live attachment; nodeId = diagram display node
|   `-- Create also accepts nodeId=canvas; otherwise base pins anchor
|-- Preconditions: expectedVersion + baseRevisionId; checked before work
|-- Operation-specific inputs
|   |-- EditDiagramInput: optional subtree {contentNodeId, revisionId}
|   |-- CreateDiagramInput: optional count 1..4; new diagrams beside anchor
|   `-- ExtendDiagramInput: required origin {column,row} + sources (1..500)
|-- prompt: instruction, with [ref N] citing references[N-1]
|-- template?: ID/version/options + optional edited Markdown; operation checked
|-- references?: up to 20 immutable diagramId/revisionId/label references
|   `-- diagram OR nodes {nodeIds, range}; independent of mutable selection
|-- sources: content-node anchors; origin: nonnegative canvas grid position
|-- agentContextId?: scoped uploaded history -> resolved snapshot [D3]
`-- requestId: session-scoped identity; changed operation/input/context rejects
